suite: World View V1 Field Package / Tiling Validation Vectors
contract: ME-05-02 Field Payload Package & Tiling Contract V0.1

cases.scenario: Read manifest and one tile from a valid package without decoding unrelated tiles.
Read a tile by stable integer tile_x/tile_y address independent of filesystem path.
Reject an unsupported package magic or required format version.
Reject a header section offset/length that overflows integer arithmetic.
Reject a manifest section or tile payload range extending beyond package length.
Reject overlapping tile payload byte ranges.
Reject duplicate tile coordinates in the tile directory.
Reject a missing tile entry intersecting the declared storage grid.
Reject tile coordinates outside the declared grid.
Reject a directory whose entries are not in canonical order.
Reject tile dimensions inconsistent with the grid or edge-tile valid dimensions.
Reject a decoded byte count inconsistent with dimensions and value encoding.
Reject a tile whose uncompressed content hash does not match its directory entry.
Reject a package whose full Core Asset hash does not match its exact bytes.
Reject an unknown required codec or unsupported codec version.
Reject a compressed tile whose declared or decoded size exceeds safe limits.
Read an uncompressed none-codec fixture with exact expected values.
Read row-major tile values with X-fastest ordering and deterministic edge-tile dimensions.
Reject NaN or infinity in elevation tile payload.
Reject an elevation precision profile whose quantization metadata is absent or inconsistent.
Reject a land/water tile containing an unregistered category code.
Reject a payload that conflates no-data with valid zero or a registered category.
Preserve land, water, unknown, outside_coverage and no-data as distinct sample outcomes.
Read partial coverage without inferring a coastline from a tile, grid or coverage edge.
Assemble calculation halo by reading neighboring storage tiles without storing duplicate halo cells.
Do not return a seamless/global calculation result when required neighbor or basin context is unavailable.
Build a new package after editing one tile while preserving all other tile logical content exactly.
Stream package creation with bounded memory without materializing the complete field in RAM.
Attempt to modify a tile payload in a previously published immutable package.
Attempt to reuse encoded tile bytes with a different codec version or encoding profile.
Reuse exact encoded tile blocks only when codec and all interpretation parameters match.
Cancel package construction before publication; leave formal Field Revision and current pointer unchanged.
Publish package bytes but fail the SQLite transaction; do not expose a Field Revision/current pointer update.
Attempt publication against a stale expected Field Revision; reject CAS and require rebase/review.
Two concurrent readers access the same immutable package without mutable buffer interference.
Evict a decoded tile cache entry and rebuild it from the immutable package.
Use a stale cache entry keyed without the package hash or decoder compatibility version.
Verify equal canonical manifest/tile inputs produce identical package bytes under the same writer/codec version.
Verify a codec/format version change produces a distinct package compatibility identity.
Attempt to perform package I/O, decompression or hashing inside a renderer callback.
Verify Windows and macOS readers decode the same canonical tile values and category states.
Compare 128x128, 256x256 and 512x512 tile candidates on representative read/edit/calculation workloads.
Compare elevation 32-bit, 64-bit and quantized profiles against declared precision/error bounds.
Infer a multi-resolution overview as an authoritative source level without an explicit Field Revision.
Resample a source field explicitly and publish the resampled content as a new Field Revision with transformation provenance.
